visualCharacteristics.purpose: Interactive process workflow: chevron stage tabs revealing the products for each stage
visualCharacteristics.description: A row of chevron/arrow-shaped stage buttons (ARIA tablist): brand red with white text for the active stage, grey with dark text for selectable stages, light grey for disabled stages (no content, aria-disabled, not selectable). A stage may carry a subtitle under its title. The panel shows an optional row of smaller grey step chevrons (ordered list), text and a responsive grid of product thumbnails with linked names below. On phones the stages stack vertically as down-pointing bars.

contentPattern.structure: one row per stage: title (plain text) | image (optional reference + alt) | text (rich text). Empty text and image = disabled stage. In the text, a lead paragraph directly followed by an ordered list = stage subtitle (moved into the stage button) + step chevrons; each product = a paragraph that only links to the image file (link text = alt) followed by the linked product name

usage.description: mybeckman.in interactive workflows: biomanufacturing and synthetic-biology (5 stages, first/last disabled), cell-line-development (6 stages), next-generation-sequencing (3 stages).

reuseGuidance: Use for sequential stage/step selectors whose panels list products. Use tabs-underline for product-detail tabs with rich-text panels.
